 However, automated text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus demonstrates considerable Pali-internal reuse, identifying 31 matching passages shared across 11 other Pali works [DharmaNexus]. The largest reuse partner is the first part of the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (10 matches, notably aligning segments 1.4–2.4) [DharmaNexus]. The poem also shares extended conventional verse patterns with several other *Therāpadāna* compositions, including the *Kilañjadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 236, segments 5.4–9.1 matching 3.4–7.1), the *Tālavaṇṭadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 219, segments 5.1–7.3 matching 4.1–6.3), the *Ekavandaniyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 232), the *Rahosaññakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 137), and both texts entitled *Ñāṇasaññikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 104 and Tha-Ap 130) [DharmaNexus].
